name: script-v3b
idea_origin: script-v3 official game 2 eliminated as Broke in month 10: a correctly read W- option (-2) with a near-empty wallet; the panel rounds Wealth down, so neither agent nor script saw it was negative.
hypothesis: With little visible Wealth, never take a money-losing option when another exists.
predicted_behaviour: Fewer missed Output/Network costs in review months, fewer R- on polite-but-risky options; most games pass L1 by month 12.
refutation: Games still stuck in L1 or blown up at the same rate as script-v1 (1 of 2).
